_doc: packages.json — the deploy units (ac-6asz.1). One object per package: blurb (one-line display text the README generator renders), skills[] (registry member dirs under skills/ — every entry MUST name a dir carrying SKILL.md; render-readme-packages.py refuses a dead name), agents[] / hooks[] (empty: the five agent stances are global, generated per harness from harnesses.json agent_models, and hook wiring is global in hooks/hooks.json — no package owns either), requires[] (top-level templates/factory.json keys the package's skills read; live bindings are store + triage + design_spec/routes_manifest/routes_public_manifest/ui_audit, the rest are plan-declared per the factory.json _doc and land when WS4 migrates the readers), budget {spine, loaded} (spine = member SKILL.md line cap, the always-loaded surface; loaded = all-Markdown-under-member-dirs cap; measured 2026-09-13 in _measured, budgets set above measured with headroom — Checks 13/23 read these through lint/lib/manifest.py, next bead). skills/_tools/ is stamped by EVERY package, never owned by one. ac-board ships unpackaged by design (read-only window, in no plan package list). Member lists follow the AGENTS.md v2 map (plan §WS3), corrected to on-disk names: ac-human (not ac-human-session), ui-brainstorm stays in library (ui-elevate did not absorb it).

factory-core.blurb: the production line (conductor: ac-implement; doctrine: ac-pipeline)

factory-verify.blurb: QA journeys, UI elevation, tests, hygiene

factory-ops.blurb: human command center, align, backlog intake, triage, native distribute

meta.blurb: authoring and auditing the registry itself

library.blurb: one-shot prompts, methodology, labs, multi-model access, UI critique
